newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Hondurans denounce trafficking of child prostitutes.
newsitem.headline: Hondurans denounce trafficking of child prostitutes.

text.p: A children's defence organisation on Monday condemned the kidnapping of Honduran youths who then became prostitutes in Mexico and the United States.

"There is a theft and trafficking of Honduran children that are prostituted in Mexico and the United States," the president of the Disappeared Children Protection Foundation, Rosario Godoy, told reporters.
"We've received reports from three disappeared girls that we fear have been taken from the country to be prostituted."
Women's advocate groups say the kidnappers often drive through the streets without license plates and with dark-tinted windows.

A spokesman from the Honduran Criminal Investigation Unit told Reuters a specialised task force investigated lost children but as of Monday it had no concrete information on children being kidnapped for prostitution.
Godoy said abducted children were also sold to U.S. or European couples who were desperate to adopt children and willing to pay large sums of money.
